WHAT_THIS_IS: The subjects Vancouver's block, local-area and street pages count, in bit order. The first 36 are the ones the readers assign (READING-COMPACT.md `subjects`, one decision at a time, from its own record); the last three the pipeline derives itself: a split vote from the tally or the minutes' printed opposition, and a permit's kind from the City's permit register.
ORDER_IS_LOAD_BEARING: A row's `sm` bit i means subject i of this list. Append at the end; reordering relabels every mask already published.

subjects.note: A site or an area given new zoning rules, from one address's CD-1 rezoning to a text amendment across a zone.
The plans that set what an area can become: official development plans, area plans, design guidelines.

Items decided at the public hearing where rezonings are heard, or sent on to one. A PROCESS, not a subject: it is where a rezoning is decided, and it topped every local area's list for that reason alone. Its bit stays reserved; the map counts no decision under it (the readings keep it).
